title: CADENCE: A Cardiac Atom Dictionary for Interpretable Neural Concept Extraction from ECG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.25244v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Foundation models for 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) transfer well across clinical tasks, but the physiological knowledge encoded in their representations remains opaque. We present CADENCE, a framework that decomposes an ECG foundation model into a human-interpretable, queryable dictionary of physiological concepts. Using a BatchTopK sparse autoencoder, CADENCE factorizes Layer-6 embeddings from more than nine million ECG tokens into 8,192 sparse cardiac atoms. These atoms align better than individual dense embedding dimensions with clinical phenotypes and waveform morphology, recovering arrhythmias, conduction abnormalities, infarction and repolarization patterns, chamber and axis findings, and lead- and beat-phase-specific waveform primitives. At Layer 6, the best atoms achieve mean AUROCs of 0.88 for clinical phenotypes and 0.90 for morphology, versus 0.78 and 0.83 for the best dense dimensions. Sparse atom probes match or out

translated_title: CADENCE：用于从心电图基础模型中进行可解释神经概念提取的心脏原子字典
translated_abstract: 十二导联心电图（ECG）基础模型能够很好地跨临床任务迁移，但其表示中编码的生理学知识仍然不透明。我们提出CADENCE，一个将心电图基础模型分解为人类可解释、可查询的生理学概念字典的框架。利用BatchTopK稀疏自编码器，CADENCE将来自超过九百万个心电图token的第六层嵌入分解为8,192个稀疏心脏原子。这些原子比单个密集嵌入维度更好地与临床表型和波形形态对齐，能够恢复心律失常、传导异常、梗死与复极化模式、心腔与心轴发现，以及导联特异和心动周期相位特异的波形基元。在第六层，最佳原子在临床表型上达到0.88的平均AUROC，在波形形态上达到0.90，而最佳密集维度分别仅为0.78和0.83。稀疏原子探针达到或超越（原文此处截断）
tldr: CADENCE框架利用BatchTopK稀疏自编码器将心电图基础模型的内部表示分解为8,192个可解释、可查询的稀疏心脏概念原子，这些原子在识别临床表型和波形形态方面显著优于密集嵌入维度。
en_tdlr: CADENCE uses a BatchTopK sparse autoencoder to decompose an ECG foundation model into 8,192 interpretable, queryable sparse cardiac atoms that better align with clinical phenotypes and waveform morphology than dense embedding dimensions.
